dialogues.speaker: Chest
dialogues.text: (A chest that contains some part of the Curatorium of Secrets's finances.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: We've been making a decent profit lately. Ashru might be in line for an extra meal.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You open the chest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Hmm... I'll take some out to pay the bills.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You open the chest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: That looks about right. This is all that's left after paying the bills. *sigh* If only we had a few more customers from Liyue...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You open the chest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Heh heh... Let's see how much we've made recently.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I remember Boss saying she was going to give me a bonus. How about I help m—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Huh? Where's the money? There's nothing in here but a slip of paper...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "My dear Jahoda, your bonus doesn't come from this box. Be sure to close it properly afterward."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Pfft, Boss is trying to scare me again. Maybe there's a hidden compartment inside here somewhere...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: There isn't any hidden compartment in there. Your bonus is right here.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh, thanks Boss. I—

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Eeek! BOSS!!! I-I-I was just doing a cash count!!!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I will get to work now, right now—

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Stop right there.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yes, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Lock the box properly.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yes, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Now you can go.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Yes, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Heh, that's about right. This chest can rest for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Looks like there's no way to open it...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps this chest can only be opened by the staff at the Curatorium of Secrets...)

dialogues.speaker: Zompaynco
dialogues.text: Hmm... What to do, what to do...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Mr. Zompaynco looks rather troubled.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: (Right, Boss Nef said... whatever's on his mind must be related to the Frostmoon Scions.)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (I'll come back and check again later...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Perhaps <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> would like to inspect the chest...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Sheesh... How is it that Boss seems to know everything? When did she even get there...?
